Require canonical P10-A source identity and source match across vintages
Reuse P06-E zero-based contiguous revision and anti-lookahead rules
Expose first release and revision history explicitly
Resolve current revision strictly as-of decision time
Resolve previous-at-first-release using the previous observation's latest eligible vintage at first-release observed-at
Prevent later previous-period revisions from leaking backward
Provide audit-only full revision history separate from replay-safe as-of history

dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none

rollback: Revert P10-C wrapper/policy/tests/evidence/CI/state. P06-E and P10-A/B remain unchanged.
